# Frequently asked questions

## What counts as a "world"?
A world is a living space you author in Playbox and publish — people beam in and take part, and the world remembers them across nights and places.

## Can I try before paying?
Yes. The Free tier lets you publish one world with no time limit so you can see the whole arc.

## What's the difference between a user, community, and place profile?
A user profile is you. A community profile is a shared brand or collective. A place profile represents a venue. Community and place profiles are available on Studio and above.

## Who owns my world?
You do. A world is its own database, in your own region — self-host it, move it, hand it off, or archive it. The data your world generates is yours too, and nothing runs on your world without your say. Never ads.

## Do you take a cut of what I make?
Your subscription covers the tool — work you sell yourself is entirely yours. If we distribute a world for you — licensing it to venues, streams, or homes — it's a straight split: you keep 50% of that distribution revenue, and you always own the work.

## Can I change plans later?
Anytime, up or down. Changes are prorated.

## Is there a discount for annual billing?
Annual pricing is coming; for now all plans are billed monthly.
